title: Fix 'Pointer to flat panel table invalid' error
summary: Resolve boot issues or lspci freezes caused by this Nouveau error by blacklisting the driver at boot and loading it manually later.

aliases.text: pointer to flat panel table invalid
ошибка pointer to flat panel table invalid

error_patterns: Pointer to flat panel table invalid

steps.explain: Add 'modprobe.blacklist=nouveau' to your kernel parameters in your bootloader config.
After booting, load the Nouveau module manually.

warnings: This is a workaround for specific hardware bugs. Check for kernel updates that might fix the underlying issue.
